title: HippoCampus Robotics
lead: The lab's home for getting robots running: setup guides, every project in one place, searchable code and CAD, and the tools our AI agents use.

home_cards.title: Setup
home_cards.text: Install ROS 2, set up a workstation or Raspberry Pi, bring up a vehicle, run the simulation. Replaces the old docs site page for page.

home_cards.title: Projects
home_cards.text: What the team builds and has built — every repository in the org, grouped into projects with context, status, and links.

home_cards.title: Search
home_cards.text: One search box over setup pages, projects, code symbols, and CAD parts, with deep links to the exact file or heading.

home_cards.title: Agent tools
home_cards.text: The lab's MCP servers for AI agents — GPU compute and CAD access — documented from scratch for new users.
